properties.name: Lake Simcoe watershed
properties.description: LSRCA scientific watershed derived from the 2002 DTM; context only.
properties.drainageDestination: Lake Simcoe → Lake Couchiching → Severn River → Georgian Bay (Lake Huron)
properties.flowDirectionBasis: LSRCA Our Watershed: overall outlet route only; no per-vertex direction or velocity is asserted.

properties.name: Lake Huron / Lake Ontario drainage divide
properties.description: Shared boundary of official Lake Huron and Lake Ontario basin polygons, clipped to GTA/Simcoe context. Not the moraine extent.
properties.northSide: Lake Simcoe / Georgian Bay (Lake Huron basin)
properties.caveat: Side labels apply to the local Oak Ridges reach only. Farther east, parts of the north side of the moraine drain through the Trent system to Lake Ontario.
